messages:
Priya Kapoor: FYI — new hire Juliana (Brazil) offer signed. Start Mon 2024-05-06. Need help: local bank details for payroll, pro-rated sign-on payment, and a comp-band uplift exception for Senior SWE. Can we route approvals? :wave:
Maya Chen: Congrats! Quick Q: is Juliana contractor or full-time? payroll/legal differ.
Priya Kapoor: Full-time. Local entity Brazil (BR-Redwood). Hiring manager @Luis Alvarez ok with level and urgent start.
Maya Chen: ok will start routing. Need comp justification doc & manager sign-off. @Luis please drop short 1-2 line justification here.
Luis Alvarez: +1 — replacing senior hire, market shortage in São Paulo, recommended band midpoint uplift +10%. Juliana brings infra experience. Approve.
Priya Kapoor: Also payroll cutoff is 05/03 — if we miss it first paycheck delayed. Can we do pro-rate sign-on to be paid with first payroll? It's a one-time upfront sign-on (gross) of BRL 15,000.
Jordan Lee: Finance: we can special-run if legal ok. Two asks: 1) payroll cost center? 2) tax withholding treatment (gross vs net). Send to finance-ops mailbox and cc me.
Priya Kapoor: Cost center ENG-SSC-BR, cc'd @Jordan Lee in email. What's the approval flow for comp exception? We need final sign-off today to meet payroll.
Maya Chen: Standard flow: Manager -> People Ops -> Total Rewards -> CFO for >8% uplift. Since this is +10% need Total Rewards + CFO. I'll open a ticket now.
PeopleOpsBot: Approval request 78921 created by Maya Chen. Route: TotalRewards, CFO. ETA review 24 hours. Link: https://redwood.internal/approvals/78921
Sam Patel: Total Rewards: I've reviewed market comps. Need candidate CV + benchmark doc. If CFO approves, we'll apply uplift as temporary band override for 6 months. Attach the benchmark in reply.
Priya Kapoor: attaching CV and benchmark (link): https://drive.redwood/board/Juliana-CV and https://drive.redwood/benchmarks/BR-senior-swe.pdf
Sam Patel: Got it. Sending to CFO now.
Maya Chen: small note re taxes — Brazil sign-on taxed at source, expect withholding. Legal to confirm.
Jordan Lee: Finance ok to special-run payroll if approval before 12:00 PT today. After that it's next month. Also confirm bank details: we'll need Juliana's full bank name, branch, account, CPF. Can onboarding collect?
Priya Kapoor: Onboarding checklist already sent to candidate, bank + CPF pending. Candidate can provide by Tue 05/02 EOD. If we get approval, we still might miss payroll cutoff.
Luis Alvarez: Can we delay start by one week if needed? Candidate prefers earlier but open to 1-week flex.
Priya Kapoor: Candidate prefers earliest. Asking for expedited approval.
PeopleOpsBot: Approval 78921 updated — TotalRewards approved by Sam Patel at 3745016900. Pending CFO sign-off.
Priya Kapoor: Thanks @Sam. @Maya can you nudge CFO? CFO is Oksana.
Maya Chen: pinging Oksana. Oksana — can you review approval 78921? it's +10% band uplift for Brasil senior SWE, payroll cutoff 05/03.
Oksana Petrova: reviewing now. Please DM me the benchmark pdf. Will need to confirm budget impact.
Priya Kapoor: sent DM with pdf.
Oksana Petrova: Approve. CFO sign-off granted at 3745017005. Please proceed.
PeopleOpsBot: Approval 78921 fully approved at 3745017005. Payroll special-run requested.
Jordan Lee: I'll schedule special-run. Priya — once we have bank + CPF we can process. Expect funds on 05/06 payroll.
Priya Kapoor: Thanks everyone. I'll update candidate and collect bank details. Closing loop: manager confirmed, Total Rewards + CFO approved, finance scheduled payroll special-run. :tada:
